learning_outcomes.text: The course aims to provide the student with the ability to understand and design programs that require in-depth knowledge of the program execution model, in particular, explicit memory management.

Knowledge and understanding: Provide a broad overview of the analysis and design of programs in languages that require in-depth knowledge of the execution model, especially memory management. The different problems addressed are formally defined, and both theoretical foundations and technical information are provided to understand the adopted solutions.
Applying knowledge and understanding: Solve specific programming problems by applying the studied techniques. Laboratory exercises allow students to apply the acquired knowledge.
Critical and judgment skills: Be able to evaluate the correctness of a program and its adequacy against requirements.
Communication skills: Be able to describe the choices made in the adopted solutions and explain the program execution mechanism according to the adopted model.
Learning skills: Autonomous in-depth study of some topics presented in the course through home completion of exercises proposed in the laboratory.

syllabus_topics: Implementation of basic and complex data structures (arrays, matrices, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs)
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica e Automatica (L-8)
